messages:
alex: Quick report — someone (automation) and a human both changed the same flag window; console showed the human change but audit + webhooks only listed the automation.
nina: that again. any idea which call sequence caused it?
alex: automation pipeline used PATCH /api/flags/:id (partial), human used the console which does an upsert PUT. PUT stomped the audit metadata and cleared 'last_edited_by' to service-account.
praveen: is that because we store audit as a single object on the flag? we lose per-field history.
toni: yep. current model: flag record has audit {last_actor, ts}. We should move to per-field audit entries or at least record a change set per write.
ops-bot: ALERT: change-collision spike detected 2025-11-02T14:19Z — 12 writes in 90s from service account pipeline.
nina: two things: (1) server-side merge semantics are ambiguous between PATCH and PUT and (2) console UX hides concurrent edits.
alex: proposal: implement ETag/versioning + 409 conflict with a lightweight "changed_fields" payload. Example:

HTTP PATCH /api/flags/123
If-Match: "v87"
Body: {"scope": {"pct": 40}}

200 -> {"version":"v88","applied":true}
409 -> {"current_version":"v88","changed_fields":["scope"],"diff":"scope: 20 -> 40"}

praveen: I like changed_fields. Also add an "origin" tag on changes (automation/service-account or user:id) so console can highlight which edits originated from pipelines.
toni: console UX idea: before a destructive PUT we fetch latest and show a tiny inline banner: \"This flag was updated 30s ago by automation — your changes will overwrite. [View diff] [Merge] [Cancel]\"
ops-bot: NOTE: add telemetry event flag.edit_conflict with tags {origin_incoming, origin_current, fields}.
nina: product wants low friction for small ops (hotfixes). We should do a fast-path: if user checks "force" we allow write but require a brief reason + 2FA confirmation for production flags.
alex: ops wants safe rollouts: if scope delta > 15% and origin=user then open a canary modal that suggests cohort rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and show impacted routes + estimated token delta.
praveen: token/quotas are key — add a route-impact calculator on the server side that, given new scope, returns list of routes and expected increase in QPS. Expose via webhook and console preview.
toni: implementation notes for server: maintain immutable change objects chronologically (append-only changelog) and compute current state by replay; this makes diffs trivial and gives us field-level history. Might be heavier on reads but we can snapshot every N changes.
nina: is append-only changelog feasible performance-wise? we already have audit logs but not structured per-field.
praveen: snapshotting every 50 changes should be fine. We'll store change entries with fields_changed array, actor, origin, reason. Reads hit latest snapshot + tail.
ops-bot: SCHEDULE: flag-api migration to append-log staging 2025-11-05T02:00-03:00 UTC.
alex: testing: need a concurrency test that simulates mixed PATCH/PUT from automation + manual UI clients. Also test webhooks: ensure downstream services get both base and new state in conflict case.
toni: API design detail: PUT must require If-Match header; accept without header only in non-prod or when force=true + justification.
nina: telemetry: create a "dry-run" endpoint (?preview=true) that returns diff + route impact without committing — log previews in a separate bucket so we can see how often people check before committing.
praveen: Also add a flag-list visual badge: [auto-changed] [manual-edit] [previewed] with hover showing last 3 changes. That should reduce surprise.
alex: ops: we need a runbook: 
- if collision happens -> check /flag/:id/changelog -> apply merge or revert
- emergency override process: require approver from oncall, log 2 approvers for prod

ops-bot: REMINDER: open PR for conflict-409 schema to review by 2025-11-03.
toni: I'll draft the API spec and a sample client diff modal; alex can own server prototype; praveen takes telemetry + route-impact.
nina: thanks, team. let's add the migration and tests to the release checklist and mention the opt-in dry-run for 2 weeks before making ETag required.
alex: sound plan. will link RFC in standup notes. :shipit:
ops-bot: If you hit a production divergence open #flags-collisions and ping @oncall
